initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the annual difference between motorist and cyclist deaths can be calculated from the two per-crash death fields
initial_plan.metric: annual net difference in reported deaths (motorist deaths minus cyclist deaths)
initial_plan.denominator: none; this is a difference in counts, not a rate
initial_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025; deaths counted from the corresponding per-crash cyclist and motorist death fields

data_check_interpretation.population_and_coverage: The planned population contains 2,132,218 crash rows. Every year from 2013 through 2025 has rows and a full-year date span from January 1 through December 31, including 2025.
data_check_interpretation.column_quality: Both planned death-count fields have 0 NULL rows and 0 negative-value rows; as numeric columns they cannot contain text empty/unknown markers. Zero occurs on 2,131,942 rows (about 99.99%) for cyclist deaths and 2,130,945 rows (about 99.94%) for motorist deaths.
data_check_interpretation.row_decisions: Keep all rows, including zero values, because zero is a valid per-crash death count rather than missing data; no rows are dropped for these fields. There are no NULL or negative values to drop or recode. The check gives full-year date spans, but does not independently establish reporting completeness.
data_check_interpretation.changes: No change to the initial plan.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, for the annual difference between reported motorist and cyclist death counts
final_plan.metric: annual net difference in reported deaths (motorist deaths minus cyclist deaths), calculated from the corresponding per-crash fields
final_plan.denominator: none; this is a difference in counts, not a rate
final_plan.population: all 2,132,218 police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash rows with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025; all crashes are retained, and cyclist/motorist deaths are counted from their respective fields
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; each has a full-year date span in the file
final_plan.limitations: The gap compares reported counts only, not exposure-adjusted fatality rates; the data check finds no missing or negative values in either death field and all years have full-year date spans, but date spans do not verify reporting completeness. The many zero-valued crash rows are retained as valid no-death counts.
